description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class `GLAccountInvalidDeleteException` used in the accounting module of Fineract. It signals invalid deletion attempts of GL Accounts due to specific reasons such as existing transactions, child accounts, or product mappings. The class includes an inner enum `GlAccountInvalidDeleteReason` that provides specific error messages and codes for each reason.
